Faster to walk lah!
Shiok!
Wah, uncle power!
This one correct. Steady!
Exactly like my ah ma made.
Power lah!
Swee!
Hmm… can lah.
Close enough, I'm late already.
Not bad, next time listen properly.
Ok… I drink first.
Wah lau eh.
Uncle, you blur ah?
Aiyoh!
Too slow lah, I go other stall.
Aiyoh, I wait until my kopi also cold.
Bo jio, bo kopi. I go.
Aiyoh, I order kopi leh!
Aiyoh, I order teh leh!
Aiyoh, I order Milo leh!
Aiyoh, I order yuan yang leh!
I said -O! No milk!
Where my -C? Evaporated milk!
Where the condensed milk?!
I say KOSONG! You want me diabetes ah?
Siew dai means LESS sugar lah!
Ga dai! More sugar!
Too much fiddling with my sugar!
Gao lah! Strong strong one!
Po! I want it weak!
Why so strong/weak? Normal can already!
I said PENG! Hot like this how to drink?
Why got ice? I never say peng!
Where the tarik? Must pull!
Dinosaur means MOUNTAIN of Milo!
What is this topping?!
I said da bao! Plastic bag!
I drink here lah, why bag?
Wah! You local already ah!
Steady lah, boss!
Correct! You sure you from America?
Power! Next time I charge you local price.
Ho seh bo! Correct!
Aiyoh… ang moh confirm.
Wrong lah, boss!
Hahaha, close… not really.
Wah lau, you stay here how long already?
Hello? Sleeping ah?
Too slow, the ERP also faster than you.
Eh boss, you know what "paiseh" means or not?
"Wah, this chicken rice damn shiok." Shiok means what?
Your friends go makan without you. You say "bo jio!" — means?
People queue 3 hours for free bubble tea. Very "kiasu". Means?
Put tissue packet on the seat — this one called?
Weekend you go "lepak" at East Coast. Means?
Monday morning, ERP jam, aircon spoil. Very "sian". Means?
Uncle miss the exit: "Alamak!" Means?
After this I go "makan". Means?
Marina Bay Sands very "atas" one. Means?
Your friend very "blur" today. Means?
Speed camera flash — confirm "kena" fine. Kena means?
PIE jam until Changi. Jialat! Means?
